name: nocobase-app-plugin-demo-mode
description: Build, enable or operate a dedicated NocoBase 3 demo deployment with @nocobase/app-plugin-demo-mode: a public, shared demo site whose fictional data is generated, cleared and reset, with quick visitor sign-in, write protection and optional model or Agent simulation (公开演示站、只读演示、定时重置的演示环境、 Demo Mode). Also use when changing business collections, external integrations or background jobs in an application that already depends on this plugin, so its demo dataset, cleanup and adapters stay complete. Not for example records (use the application development Skill's sample-data workflow), ordinary trial, staging or customer deployments, third-party sandbox credentials, or an in-app presentation/display mode feature.
